_comment: Weekday format map used when the agent runs with --format auto. Days are IST. Formats: image (single 4:5 card), carousel (4 to 7 cards), reel (vertical video, also uploaded to YouTube as a Short). The GitHub Actions cron decides WHEN a run happens; this file decides WHAT it makes. With the default Mon/Wed/Fri cron that is reel, carousel, reel: two Shorts a week for YouTube.
